transliteration: Ki o ushinattari, hidoku memai ga shitari shimashita ka?
translation: 気を失ったり、ひどくめまいがしたりしましたか？

english: Are you vomiting blood?
transliteration: Chi o haite imasu ka?
translation: 血を吐いていますか？

english: Are you passing black, tarry stool?
transliteration: Kurokute taaru no you na ben ga dete imasu ka?
translation: 黒くてタールのような便が出ていますか？

english: Are you passing a large amount of blood in your stool?
transliteration: Ben ni tairyou no chi ga majitte imasu ka?
translation: 便に大量の血が混じっていますか？

english: Are you unable to pass stool or gas?
transliteration: Ben mo onara mo dasenai joutai desu ka?
translation: 便もおならも出せない状態ですか？

english: Have you stopped passing urine or are you urinating much less?
transliteration: Nyou ga denaku nattari, nyou no ryou ga kanari herattari shimashita ka?
translation: 尿が出なくなったり、尿の量がかなり減ったりしましたか？

english: Do you have fever with severe abdominal pain?
transliteration: Hidoi fukutsuu to hatsunetsu ga arimasu ka?
translation: ひどい腹痛と発熱がありますか？

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: Ninshin shite iru kanousei wa arimasu ka?
translation: 妊娠している可能性はありますか？

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: Aomuke ni nete kudasai.
translation: 仰向けに寝てください。

english: Please bend your knees slightly.
transliteration: Hiza o sukoshi magete kudasai.
translation: 膝を少し曲げてください。

english: Please lift your shirt so I can examine your abdomen.
transliteration: Onaka o shinsatsu dekiru you ni, shatsu o agete kudasai.
translation: お腹を診察できるように、シャツを上げてください。

english: I am going to listen to your abdomen.
transliteration: Onaka no oto o kikimasu.
translation: お腹の音を聞きます。

english: I am going to press gently on your abdomen.
transliteration: Onaka o sotto oshimasu.
translation: お腹をそっと押します。

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: Koko o oshita toki ni itakattara oshiete kudasai.
translation: ここを押したときに痛かったら教えてください。

english: Does it hurt more when I let go?
transliteration: Te o hanasu toki no hou ga itai desu ka?
translation: 手を離すときのほうが痛いですか？

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: Shinkokyuu shite kudasai.
translation: 深呼吸してください。

english: I may need to examine your rectum, and I will explain why first.
transliteration: Chokuchou no shinsatsu ga hitsuyou ni naru baai ga arimasu. Mazu, sono riyuu o go setsumei shimasu.
translation: 直腸の診察が必要になる場合があります。まず、その理由をご説明します。

english: We would like to do some blood tests.
transliteration: Ketsueki kensa o shitai to omoimasu.
translation: 血液検査をしたいと思います。

english: We need a stool sample.
transliteration: Ben no kentai ga hitsuyou desu.
translation: 便の検体が必要です。

english: Please collect a stool sample in this container.
transliteration: Kono youki ni ben no kentai o totte kudasai.
translation: この容器に便の検体を採ってください。

english: We may need an ultrasound of your abdomen.
transliteration: Onaka no chouonpa kensa ga hitsuyou ni naru baai ga arimasu.
translation: お腹の超音波検査が必要になる場合があります。

english: We may need a CT scan of your abdomen.
transliteration: Onaka no shii-tii kensa ga hitsuyou ni naru baai ga arimasu.
translation: お腹のCT検査が必要になる場合があります。

english: A gastroscopy uses a small camera to look inside your food pipe and stomach.
transliteration: I kamera kensa de wa, chiisana kamera de shokudou to i no naka o mimasu.
translation: 胃カメラ検査では、小さなカメラで食道と胃の中を見ます。

english: A colonoscopy uses a camera to look inside your large intestine.
transliteration: Daichou naishikyou kensa de wa, kamera de daichou no naka o mimasu.
translation: 大腸内視鏡検査では、カメラで大腸の中を見ます。

english: You may need to take bowel preparation before the colonoscopy.
transliteration: Daichou naishikyou kensa no mae ni, chou o kirei ni suru kusuri o nomu hitsuyou ga aru kamo shiremasen.
translation: 大腸内視鏡検査の前に、腸をきれいにする薬を飲む必要があるかもしれません。

english: You may need to avoid eating or drinking before the procedure.
transliteration: Shochi no mae ni, tabetari nondari shinai you ni suru hitsuyou ga aru kamo shiremasen.
translation: 処置の前に、食べたり飲んだりしないようにする必要があるかもしれません。

english: We will explain the risks and ask for your consent before the procedure.
transliteration: Shochi no mae ni, risuku o go setsumei shi, doui o itadakimasu.
translation: 処置の前に、リスクをご説明し、同意をいただきます。

english: We will give you fluids to prevent dehydration.
transliteration: Dassui o fusegu tame ni, suibun o hokyuu shimasu.
translation: 脱水を防ぐために、水分を補給します。

english: Take small sips of water frequently.
transliteration: Mizu o sukoshi zutsu, komame ni nonde kudasai.
translation: 水を少しずつ、こまめに飲んでください。

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: Shohou doori ni kono kusuri o nonde kudasai.
translation: 処方どおりにこの薬を飲んでください。

english: This medicine may help reduce stomach acid.
transliteration: Kono kusuri wa isan o osaeru no ni yakudatsu koto ga arimasu.
translation: この薬は胃酸を抑えるのに役立つことがあります。

english: Avoid foods that make your symptoms worse.
transliteration: Shoujou o akka saseru tabemono wa sakete kudasai.
translation: 症状を悪化させる食べ物は避けてください。

english: Do not take painkillers such as ibuprofen unless your clinician advises it.
transliteration: Iryousha kara shiji ga nai kagiri, ibupurofen nado no itamidome wa nomanaide kudasai.
translation: 医療者から指示がない限り、イブプロフェンなどの痛み止めは飲まないでください。

english: We may refer you to a digestive system specialist.
transliteration: Shoukaki no senmon'i o shoukai suru baai ga arimasu.
translation: 消化器の専門医を紹介する場合があります。

english: If you develop severe pain or bleeding, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: Tsuyoi itami ya shukketsu ga attara, sugu ni iryō kikan o jushin shite kudasai.
translation: 強い痛みや出血があったら、すぐに医療機関を受診してください。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: Nanika shitsumon wa arimasu ka?
translation: 何か質問はありますか？

english: Can you tell me what symptoms would make you seek urgent help?
transliteration: Dono yō na shōjō ga attara, sugu ni tasuke o motomeru hitsuyō ga aru to omoimasu ka?
translation: どのような症状があったら、すぐに助けを求める必要があると思いますか？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: Jikai no shinsatsu no yoyaku o tehai shimasu.
translation: 次回の診察の予約を手配します。

english: Please return if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: Shōjō ga akka shitara, mata jushin shite kudasai.
translation: 症状が悪化したら、また受診してください。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: Kyō wa ohanashi shite kudasatte, arigatō gozaimasu.
translation: 今日はお話ししてくださって、ありがとうございます。

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: Konnichiwa. Watashi wa anata no iryō chīmu no ichiin desu.
translation: こんにちは。私はあなたの医療チームの一員です。

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: Kyō wa dō saremashita ka?
translation: 今日はどうされましたか？

english: I would like to ask some questions about your urinary health.
transliteration: Nyō no kenkō ni tsuite, ikutsuka shitsumon sasete kudasai.
translation: 尿の健康について、いくつか質問させてください。

english: Some questions may be personal; is that okay?
transliteration: Kojinteki na shitsumon o suru koto ga arimasu ga, yoroshii desu ka?
translation: 個人的な質問をすることがありますが、よろしいですか？

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: Shinsatsu shite mo yoroshii desu ka?
translation: 診察してもよろしいですか？

english: Would you like a chaperone present for the examination?
transliteration: Shinsatsu no toki ni tsukisoi no hito ga iru hō ga yoi desu ka?
translation: 診察のときに付き添いの人がいるほうがよいですか？

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: Tsūyaku ga hitsuyō desu ka?
translation: 通訳が必要ですか？

english: When did the problem begin?
transliteration: Itsu kara hajimarimashita ka?
translation: いつから始まりましたか？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: Totsuzen hajimarimashita ka, soretomo jojoni hajimarimashita ka?
translation: 突然始まりましたか、それとも徐々に始まりましたか？

english: How long have you had these symptoms?
transliteration: Kono shōjō wa dono kurai tsuzuite imasu ka?
translation: この症状はどのくらい続いていますか？

english: Are the symptoms getting better or worse?
transliteration: Shōjō wa yoku natte imasu ka, soretomo waruku natte imasu ka?
translation: 症状は良くなっていますか、それとも悪くなっていますか？

english: Does the problem come and go?
transliteration: Shōjō wa detari osamattari shimasu ka?
translation: 症状は出たり治まったりしますか？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: Izen ni mo onaji shōjō ga arimashita ka?
translation: 以前にも同じ症状がありましたか？

english: What concerns you most about these symptoms?
transliteration: Kono shōjō ni tsuite, ichiban shinpai na koto wa nan desu ka?
translation: この症状について、いちばん心配なことは何ですか？

english: Are you urinating more often than usual?
transliteration: Itsumo yori hinpan ni hainyō shite imasu ka?
translation: いつもより頻繁に排尿していますか？

english: How many times do you urinate during the day?
transliteration: Nitchū wa nankai kurai hainyō shimasu ka?
translation: 日中は何回くらい排尿しますか？

english: How many times do you wake at night to urinate?
transliteration: Yoru, hainyō no tame ni nankai okimasu ka?
translation: 夜、排尿のために何回起きますか？

english: Do you suddenly feel an urgent need to urinate?
transliteration: Kyū ni nyōi o kanjiru koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 急に尿意を感じることがありますか？

english: Can you hold your urine until you reach the toilet?
transliteration: Toire ni tsuku made, nyō o gaman dekimasu ka?
translation: トイレに着くまで、尿を我慢できますか？

english: Are you passing more urine than usual?
transliteration: Itsumo yori nyō no ryō ga ōi desu ka?
translation: いつもより尿の量が多いですか？

english: Are you passing less urine than usual?
transliteration: Itsumo yori nyō no ryō ga sukunai desu ka?
translation: いつもより尿の量が少ないですか？

english: When did you last pass urine?
transliteration: Saigo ni hainyō shita no wa itsu desu ka?
translation: 最後に排尿したのはいつですか？

english: Does it burn or hurt when you urinate?
transliteration: Hainyō suru toki ni, shimitari itandari shimasu ka?
translation: 排尿するときに、しみたり痛んだりしますか？

english: Do you have pain in your lower abdomen?
transliteration: Kafukubu ni itami ga arimasu ka?
translation: 下腹部に痛みがありますか？

english: Do you have fever or chills?
transliteration: Netsu ya samuke ga arimasu ka?
translation: 熱や寒気がありますか？

english: Is your urine cloudy?
transliteration: Nyō ga nigotte imasu ka?
translation: 尿が濁っていますか？

english: Does your urine have a strong or unusual smell?
transliteration: Nyō ni tsuyoi nioi ya, itsumo to chigau nioi ga arimasu ka?
translation: 尿に強いにおいや、いつもと違うにおいがありますか？

english: Have you noticed blood in your urine?
transliteration: Nyō ni chi ga majitte iru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 尿に血が混じっていることに気づきましたか？

english: Is your urine pink, red, or brown?
transliteration: Nyō wa pinku-iro, aka-iro, mata wa chairo desu ka?
translation: 尿はピンク色、赤色、または茶色ですか？

english: Have you noticed foam in your urine?
transliteration: Nyō ni awa ga aru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 尿に泡があることに気づきましたか？

english: Have you had a urinary tract infection before?
transliteration: Izen, nyōro kansenshō ni natta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 以前、尿路感染症になったことがありますか？

english: Have you taken antibiotics for this problem?
transliteration: Kono shōjō ni taishite kōseibusshitsu o nomimashita ka?
translation: この症状に対して抗生物質を飲みましたか？

english: Is it difficult to start urinating?
transliteration: Hainyō o hajime nikui desu ka?
translation: 排尿を始めにくいですか？

english: Is your urine stream weaker than before?
transliteration: Nyō no ikioi ga izen yori yowaku natte imasu ka?
translation: 尿の勢いが以前より弱くなっていますか？

english: Does your urine stream stop and start?
transliteration: Nyō ga togiretari, mata detari shimasu ka?
translation: 尿が途切れたり、また出たりしますか？

english: Do you have to strain to urinate?
transliteration: Hainyō suru toki ni chikaramu hitsuyō ga arimasu ka?
translation: 排尿するときに力む必要がありますか？

english: Do you feel your bladder is not completely empty afterward?
transliteration: Hainyō-go mo bōkō ni nyō ga nokotte iru kanji ga shimasu ka?
translation: 排尿後も膀胱に尿が残っている感じがしますか？

english: Do you dribble urine after finishing?
transliteration: Hainyō-go ni nyō ga sukoshi moremasu ka?
translation: 排尿後に尿が少し漏れますか？

english: Have you ever been told your prostate is enlarged?
transliteration: Zेंritsen ga ōkiku natte iru to iwareta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 前立腺が大きくなっていると言われたことがありますか？

english: Have you taken medication for an enlarged prostate?
transliteration: Zेंritsen hidai no kusuri o nonda koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 前立腺肥大の薬を飲んだことがありますか？

english: Have you ever been unable to pass urine at all?
transliteration: Nyō ga mattaku denaku natta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 尿がまったく出なくなったことがありますか？

english: Do you ever leak urine without meaning to?
transliteration: Ito sezu nyō ga moreru koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 意図せず尿が漏れることがありますか？

english: Do you leak urine when coughing, laughing, or lifting?
transliteration: Seki ya waratta toki, mata wa omoi mono o motta toki ni nyō ga moremasu ka?
translation: せきや笑ったとき、または重い物を持ったときに尿が漏れますか？

english: Do you leak urine on the way to the toilet?
transliteration: Toire ni iku tochū de nyō ga moremasu ka?
translation: トイレに行く途中で尿が漏れますか？

english: Do you use pads because of urine leakage?
transliteration: Nyōmore no tame ni paddo o tsukatte imasu ka?
translation: 尿漏れのためにパッドを使っていますか？

english: How often does urine leakage happen?
transliteration: Nyōmore wa dono kurai no hindo de okorimasu ka?
translation: 尿漏れはどのくらいの頻度で起こりますか？

english: Do you feel pressure or a bulge in your pelvic area?
transliteration: Kotsuban no atari ni appakukan ya fukurami ga arimasu ka?
translation: 骨盤のあたりに圧迫感や膨らみがありますか？

english: Does urine leakage affect your daily activities?
transliteration: Nyōmore wa nichijō seikatsu ni eikyō shite imasu ka?
translation: 尿漏れは日常生活に影響していますか？

english: Do you have pain in your side or back?
transliteration: Wakibara ya senaka ni itami ga arimasu ka?
translation: 脇腹や背中に痛みがありますか？

english: Is the pain on the right side or left side?
transliteration: Itami wa migigawa desu ka, soretomo hidarigawa desu ka?
translation: 痛みは右側ですか、それとも左側ですか？

english: Does the pain spread toward your groin?
transliteration: Itami wa ashi no tsukene ni hirogarimasu ka?
translation: 痛みは足の付け根に広がりますか？

english: Does the pain come in waves?
transliteration: Itami wa nami no yō ni tsuyoku nattari yowaku nattari shimasu ka?
translation: 痛みは波のように強くなったり弱くなったりしますか？

english: Is the pain severe enough that you cannot sit still?
transliteration: Jitto suwatte irarenai hodo itami ga tsuyoi desu ka?
translation: じっと座っていられないほど痛みが強いですか？

english: Do you feel nauseated or have you vomited?
transliteration: Hakike ga arimasu ka, mata wa hakimashita ka?
translation: 吐き気がありますか、または吐きましたか？

english: Have you ever had a kidney stone?
transliteration: Jinzō kesseki ni natta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 腎臓結石になったことがありますか？

english: Have you noticed sand or small stones in your urine?
transliteration: Nyō ni suna ya chiisana ishi no yō na mono ga majitte iru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 尿に砂や小さな石のようなものが混じっていることに気づきましたか？

english: Have you had fever along with this pain?
transliteration: Kono itami to issho ni netsu ga demashita ka?
translation: この痛みと一緒に熱が出ましたか？

english: Have you been told you have kidney disease?
transliteration: Jinzō no byōki ga aru to iwareta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 腎臓の病気があると言われたことがありますか？

english: Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
transliteration: Tōnyōbyō ya kōketsuatsu ga arimasu ka?
translation: 糖尿病や高血圧がありますか？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your legs or face?
transliteration: Ashi ya kao no mukumi ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 足や顔のむくみに気づきましたか？

english: Have you been drinking less water than usual?
transliteration: Itsumo yori mizu o nomu ryō ga hette imasu ka?
translation: いつもより水を飲む量が減っていますか？

english: How much water do you drink in a day?
transliteration: Ichinichi ni dono kurai mizu o nomimasu ka?
translation: 1日にどのくらい水を飲みますか？

english: Have you ever needed dialysis?
transliteration: Tōseki ga hitsuyō ni natta koto ga arimasu ka?

english: Did you injure your groin recently?

english: Do you have pain or a rash on your genitals?

english: Have you noticed any sores or blisters?

english: Is there any unusual discharge from the penis or urethra?
transliteration: Inkei ya nyōdō kara, itsumo to chigau bunpitsubutsu ga dete imasu ka?
translation: 陰茎や尿道から、いつもと違う分泌物が出ていますか？

english: Do you have pain during sexual activity?
transliteration: Seikōi-chū ni itami ga arimasu ka?

english: Do you have difficulty getting or keeping an erection?

english: Have you noticed blood in your semen?

translation: 精液に血が混じっていることに気づきましたか？

english: Are you sexually active?

english: Do you use condoms or other protection?

english: Would you like testing for sexually transmitted infections?

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?

english: Do you have pain in your pelvis?

english: Do you have vaginal discharge or irritation?
transliteration: Orimono ya kayumi, shigekikan ga arimasu ka?

english: When was your last menstrual period?
transliteration: Saigo no gekkei wa itsu deshita ka?
translation: 最後の月経はいつでしたか？

english: Are you having any unusual vaginal bleeding?
transliteration: Itsumo to chigau chitsu kara no shukketsu ga arimasu ka?
translation: いつもと違う膣からの出血がありますか？

english: Do your urinary symptoms change around your period?
transliteration: Gekkei no zengo de, hainyō no shōjō ni henka ga arimasu ka?
translation: 月経の前後で、排尿の症状に変化がありますか？

english: Have you had any pregnancies or deliveries?
transliteration: Ninshin ya shussan o keiken shita koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 妊娠や出産を経験したことがありますか？

english: Have you had surgery in your pelvis?
transliteration: Kotsuban no shujutsu o uketa koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 骨盤の手術を受けたことがありますか？

english: Do you currently have a urinary catheter?
transliteration: Genzai, nyōdō katēteru o irete imasu ka?
translation: 現在、尿道カテーテルを入れていますか？

english: When was your catheter last changed?
transliteration: Katēteru o saigo ni kōkan shita no wa itsu desu ka?
translation: カテーテルを最後に交換したのはいつですか？

english: Is urine draining into the bag normally?
transliteration: Nyō wa fukuro ni tsūjō dōri nagarete imasu ka?
translation: 尿は袋に通常どおり流れていますか？

english: Is there pain or leakage around the catheter?
transliteration: Katēteru no mawari ni itami ya nyōmore wa arimasu ka?
translation: カテーテルの周りに痛みや尿漏れはありますか？

english: Have you noticed blood or clots in the catheter bag?
transliteration: Katēteru no baggu ni chi ya chi no katamari ga haitte iru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: カテーテルのバッグに血や血のかたまりが入っていることに気づきましたか？

english: Has the catheter stopped draining?
transliteration: Katēteru kara nyō ga denaku narimashita ka?
translation: カテーテルから尿が出なくなりましたか？

english: Do you use a catheter yourself to empty your bladder?
transliteration: Go-jibun de katēteru o tsukatte bōkō no nyō o dashite imasu ka?
translation: ご自分でカテーテルを使って膀胱の尿を出していますか？

english: Have you had urinary tract infections before?
transliteration: Kore made ni nyōro kansen-shō ni kakatta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: これまでに尿路感染症にかかったことはありますか？

english: Have you had any surgery on your kidneys or bladder?
transliteration: Jinzō ya bōkō no shujutsu o uketa koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 腎臓や膀胱の手術を受けたことはありますか？

english: Have you ever had surgery on your prostate?
transliteration: Zentai-sen no shujutsu o uketa koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 前立腺の手術を受けたことはありますか？

english: Have you had cancer of the kidney, bladder, or prostate?
transliteration: Jinzō, bōkō, mata wa zentai-sen no gan ni kakatta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 腎臓、膀胱、または前立腺のがんにかかったことはありますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have kidney disease?
transliteration: Go-kazoku ni jinzō no byōki ga aru kata wa imasu ka?
translation: ご家族に腎臓の病気がある方はいますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have kidney stones?
transliteration: Go-kazoku ni jinzō kesseki ga aru kata wa imasu ka?
translation: ご家族に腎臓結石がある方はいますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have prostate cancer?
transliteration: Go-kazoku ni zentai-sen gan no kata wa imasu ka?
translation: ご家族に前立腺がんの方はいますか？

english: Do you smoke or have you smoked in the past?
transliteration: Ima tabako o sutte imasu ka, mata wa izen sutte imashita ka?
translation: 今たばこを吸っていますか、または以前吸っていましたか？

english: What medicines are you currently taking?
transliteration: Genzai, dono yō na o-kusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 現在、どのようなお薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Have you started any new medicine recently?
transliteration: Saikin, atarashii kusuri o nomihajimemashita ka?
translation: 最近、新しい薬を飲み始めましたか？

english: Are you taking antibiotics for a urinary infection?
transliteration: Nyōro kansen-shō no tame ni kōseibusshitsu o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 尿路感染症のために抗生物質を飲んでいますか？

english: How many days have you taken the antibiotic?
transliteration: Kōseibusshitsu o nannichikan nomimashita ka?
translation: 抗生物質を何日間飲みましたか？

english: Do you take medicines for your prostate?
transliteration: Zentai-sen no kusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 前立腺の薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take medicine to help with erections?
transliteration: Bokki o tasukeru kusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 勃起を助ける薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take painkillers such as ibuprofen regularly?
transliteration: Ibu-purofen nado no itamidome o teikiteki ni nonde imasu ka?
translation: イブプロフェンなどの痛み止めを定期的に飲んでいますか？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: Kusuri de arerugī ga deta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 薬でアレルギーが出たことはありますか？

english: Are you completely unable to pass urine?
transliteration: Mattaku nyō ga denai jōtai desu ka?
translation: まったく尿が出ない状態ですか？

english: Do you have severe pain in a testicle that began suddenly?
transliteration: Katahō no kōgan ni totsuzen, tsuyoi itami ga demashita ka?
translation: 片方の睾丸に突然、強い痛みが出ましたか？

english: Do you have fever with severe back or side pain?
transliteration: Netsu ga ari, senaka ya wakibara ni tsuyoi itami ga arimasu ka?
translation: 熱があり、背中や脇腹に強い痛みがありますか？

english: Are you passing large blood clots in your urine?
transliteration: Nyō ni ōkina chi no katamari ga dete imasu ka?
translation: 尿に大きな血のかたまりが出ていますか？

english: Are you feeling faint, confused, or very unwell?
transliteration: Ki ga tōku naru, konran suru, mata wa hidoku guai ga warui to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 気が遠くなる、混乱する、またはひどく具合が悪いと感じますか？

english: Have you had new weakness or numbness in your legs?
transliteration: Saikin, ashi ni chikara ga hairanakunattari, shibiretari shimashita ka?
translation: 最近、脚に力が入らなくなったり、しびれたりしましたか？

english: Have you lost feeling around your groin or private parts?
transliteration: Mata ya inbu no kankaku ga nakunarimashita ka?
translation: 股や陰部の感覚がなくなりましたか？

english: Have you suddenly lost control of your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: Totsuzen, nyō ya ben o gaman dekinaku narimashita ka?
translation: 突然、尿や便を我慢できなくなりましたか？

english: Have you been vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: Haite, suibun o totte mo hakazu ni irarenai jōtai desu ka?
translation: 吐いて、水分をとっても吐かずにいられない状態ですか？

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: Aomuke ni nete kudasai.
translation: 仰向けに寝てください。

english: I will examine your abdomen and lower back.
transliteration: Onaka to koshi o shinsatsu shimasu.
translation: お腹と腰を診察します。

english: Please point to the area that hurts.
transliteration: Itamu basho o yubi de shimeshite kudasai.
translation: 痛む場所を指で示してください。

english: I will press gently on your lower abdomen.
transliteration: Kafukubu o yasashiku oshimasu.
translation: 下腹部を優しく押します。

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: Koko o oshita toki ni itakattara oshiete kudasai.
translation: ここを押したときに痛かったら教えてください。

english: I am going to tap gently on your back near the kidneys.
transliteration: Jinzō no atari no senaka o yasashiku tatakimasu.
translation: 腎臓のあたりの背中を優しくたたきます。

english: I may need to examine your genital area; I will explain and ask permission first.
transliteration: Inbu o shinsatsu suru hitsuyō ga aru kamo shiremasen. Saki ni setsumei shite, kyoka o itadakimasu.
translation: 陰部を診察する必要があるかもしれません。先に説明して、許可をいただきます。

english: Please tell me immediately if anything hurts.
transliteration: Itai tokoro ga areba, sugu ni oshiete kudasai.
translation: 痛いところがあれば、すぐに教えてください。

english: We can pause or stop the examination at any time.
transliteration: Shinsatsu wa itsu demo ichiji chūdan shitari, yametari dekimasu.
translation: 診察はいつでも一時中断したり、やめたりできます。

english: A prostate examination may be helpful; I will explain it first.
transliteration: Zentai-sen no shinsatsu o suru to yakudatsu baai ga arimasu. Saki ni setsumei shimasu.
translation: 前立腺の診察をすると役立つ場合があります。先に説明します。

english: The prostate examination may involve a gloved finger in the rectum.
transliteration: Zentai-sen no shinsatsu de wa, tebukuro o shita yubi o kōmon kara ireru koto ga arimasu.
translation: 前立腺の診察では、手袋をした指を肛門から入れることがあります。

english: Is it okay to proceed with this examination?
transliteration: Kono shinsatsu o ukete mo yoroshii desu ka?
translation: この診察を受けてもよろしいですか？

english: Would you like a chaperone for this examination?
transliteration: Kono shinsatsu ni tsukisoi no hito o kibō saremasu ka?
translation: この診察に付き添いの人を希望されますか？

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: Yokomuki ni natte kudasai.
translation: 横向きになってください。

english: Please bend your knees toward your chest.
transliteration: Hiza o mune no hō ni magete kudasai.
translation: 膝を胸のほうに曲げてください。

english: I will check for swelling or tenderness in the scrotum.
transliteration: Inō no hare ya itami o kakunin shimasu.
translation: 陰嚢の腫れや痛みを確認します。

english: Please cough while I examine your groin.
transliteration: Mata no atari o shinsatsu shite iru aida, seki o shite kudasai.
translation: 股のあたりを診察している間、咳をしてください。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: Nyō no kentai ga hitsuyō desu.
translation: 尿の検体が必要です。

english: Please collect urine in this clean container.
transliteration: Kono seiketsu na yōki ni nyō o totte kudasai.
translation: この清潔な容器に尿を採ってください。

english: We will test your urine for infection and blood.
transliteration: Nyō o shirabete, kansen ya chi ga aru ka kakunin shimasu.
translation: 尿を調べて、感染や血があるか確認します。

english: We may send the urine for a culture.
transliteration: Nyō o baiyō kensa ni dasu koto ga arimasu.
translation: 尿を培養検査に出すことがあります。

english: We would like to check your kidney function with blood tests.
transliteration: Ketsueki kensa de jinzō no hataraki o shirabetai to omoimasu.
translation: 血液検査で腎臓の働きを調べたいと思います。

english: We may arrange an ultrasound of your kidneys and bladder.
transliteration: Jinzō to bōkō no chōonpa kensa o tehai suru koto ga arimasu.
translation: 腎臓と膀胱の超音波検査を手配することがあります。

english: We may need a CT scan to look for kidney stones.
transliteration: Jinzō kesseki o shiraberu tame ni shī tī kensa ga hitsuyō ni naru koto ga arimasu.
translation: 腎臓結石を調べるためにCT検査が必要になることがあります。

english: We may check how much urine remains in your bladder after you urinate.
transliteration: Hainyō-go ni bōkō ni dore kurai nyō ga nokotte iru ka shiraberu koto ga arimasu.
translation: 排尿後に膀胱にどれくらい尿が残っているか調べることがあります。

english: We may need a camera examination of the bladder called cystoscopy.
transliteration: Bōkōkyō kensa to iu, kamera de bōkō no naka o miru kensa ga hitsuyō ni naru koto ga arimasu.
translation: 膀胱鏡検査という、カメラで膀胱の中を見る検査が必要になることがあります。

english: We may need to give you antibiotics.
transliteration: Kōseibusshitsu o tsukau hitsuyō ga aru kamo shiremasen.
translation: 抗生物質を使う必要があるかもしれません。

english: Please take this medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: Kono kusuri wa shohō-dōri ni nonde kudasai.
translation: この薬は処方どおりに飲んでください。

english: You may need a catheter to drain your bladder.
transliteration: Bōkō kara nyō o dasu tame ni katēteru ga hitsuyō ni naru koto ga arimasu.
translation: 膀胱から尿を出すためにカテーテルが必要になることがあります。

english: We will explain the catheter procedure and ask for your consent.
transliteration: Katēteru o ireru tejun o setsumei shi, dōi o itadakimasu.
translation: カテーテルを入れる手順を説明し、同意をいただきます。

english: Please keep the catheter bag below the level of your bladder.
transliteration: Katēteru no baggu wa bōkō yori hikui ichi ni oite kudasai.
translation: カテーテルのバッグは膀胱より低い位置に置いてください。

english: You may need to strain your urine to collect a stone.
transliteration: Kesseki o toru tame ni, nyō o koshite itadaku koto ga arimasu.
translation: 結石を採るために、尿をこしていただくことがあります。

english: We may refer you to a urologist.
transliteration: Hinyōkika no senmon'i o shōkai suru koto ga arimasu.
translation: 泌尿器科の専門医を紹介することがあります。

english: We may refer you to a kidney specialist.
transliteration: Jinzō no senmon'i o shōkai suru koto ga arimasu.
translation: 腎臓の専門医を紹介することがあります。

english: If you cannot urinate or develop severe pain or fever, seek urgent care.
transliteration: Nyō ga denaku nattari, tsuyoi itami ya netsu ga detari shita baai wa, sugu ni iryō kikan o jushin shite kudasai.
translation: 尿が出なくなったり、強い痛みや熱が出たりした場合は、すぐに医療機関を受診してください。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: Nanika shitsumon wa arimasu ka?
translation: 何か質問はありますか？

english: Can you tell me which symptoms would need urgent medical attention?
transliteration: Dono yō na shōjō ga areba, sugu ni iryō kikan o jushin suru hitsuyō ga aru ka setsumei shite itadakemasu ka?
translation: どのような症状があれば、すぐに医療機関を受診する必要があるか説明していただけますか？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: Saishin no yoyaku o tehai shimasu.
translation: 再診の予約を手配します。

english: Please return if your symptoms worsen.
transliteration: Shōjō ga akka shitara, mata jushin shite kudasai.
translation: 症状が悪化したら、また受診してください。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: Kyō wa ohanashi itadaki, arigatō gozaimashita.
translation: 今日はお話しいただき、ありがとうございました。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: Kyō wa dō saremashita ka?
translation: 今日はどうされましたか？

english: When did your symptoms start?
transliteration: Shōjō wa itsu hajimarimashita ka?
translation: 症状はいつ始まりましたか？

english: Have your symptoms been getting worse?
transliteration: Shōjō wa akka shite imasu ka?
translation: 症状は悪化していますか？

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: Hoka ni nanika shōjō wa arimasu ka?
translation: ほかに何か症状はありますか？

english: May I ask about your medical history?
transliteration: Kore made no byōreki ni tsuite ukagatte mo yoroshii desu ka?
translation: これまでの病歴について伺ってもよろしいですか？

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: Shinsatsu shite mo yoroshii desu ka?
translation: 診察してもよろしいですか？

english: Would you like an interpreter?
transliteration: Tsūyaku o go-kibō desu ka?
translation: 通訳をご希望ですか？

english: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
transliteration: Tōnyōbyō to shindan sareta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 糖尿病と診断されたことはありますか？

english: Do you have type 1 or type 2 diabetes?
transliteration: Ichi-gata tōnyōbyō desu ka, soretomo ni-gata tōnyōbyō desu ka?
translation: 1型糖尿病ですか、それとも2型糖尿病ですか？

english: How long have you had diabetes?
transliteration: Tōnyōbyō ni natte dore kurai desu ka?
translation: 糖尿病になってどれくらいですか？

english: Are you more thirsty than usual?
transliteration: Itsumo yori nodo ga kawakimasu ka?
translation: いつもより喉が渇きますか？

english: Are you urinating more often?
transliteration: Itsumo yori hinpan ni nyō ga demasu ka?
translation: いつもより頻繁に尿が出ますか？

english: Do you wake up at night to urinate?
transliteration: Yoru, nyō o suru tame ni me ga samemasu ka?
translation: 夜、尿をするために目が覚めますか？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: Toku ni nani mo shite inai noni taijū ga herimashita ka?
translation: 特に何もしていないのに体重が減りましたか？

english: Do you feel more hungry than usual?
transliteration: Itsumo yori onaka ga sukimすか?
translation: いつもよりお腹が空きますか？

english: Have you noticed blurred vision?
transliteration: Shikai ga boyakeru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 視界がぼやけることに気づきましたか？

english: Do you feel unusually tired?
transliteration: Itsumo yori tsukareyasui desu ka?
translation: いつもより疲れやすいですか？

english: Have you had frequent infections?
transliteration: Kansenshō ni nando mo kakarimashita ka?
translation: 感染症に何度もかかりましたか？

english: Do your wounds take a long time to heal?
transliteration: Kizu ga naoru no ni jikan ga kakarimasu ka?
translation: 傷が治るのに時間がかかりますか？

english: Do you check your blood sugar at home?
transliteration: Jitaku de kettōchi o hak mattersu ka?
translation: 自宅で血糖値を測っていますか？

english: How often do you check your blood sugar?
transliteration: Dono kurai no hindo de kettōchi o hakarimasu ka?
translation: どのくらいの頻度で血糖値を測っていますか？

english: What was your last blood sugar reading?
transliteration: Saigo ni hakatta kettōchi wa ikutsu deshita ka?
translation: 最後に測った血糖値はいくつでしたか？

english: Do you use a continuous glucose monitor?
transliteration: Jizoku kettō sokuteiki o tsukatte imasu ka?
translation: 持続血糖測定器を使っていますか？

english: Have you brought your glucose readings?
transliteration: Kettōchi no kiroku o motte kimashita ka?
translation: 血糖値の記録を持ってきましたか？

english: Have you had an HbA1c blood test?
transliteration: Eichi bī ē wan no ketsueki kensa o uketa koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: HbA1cの血液検査を受けたことはありますか？

english: We will check your blood sugar now.
transliteration: Ima, kettōchi o hakarimasu.
translation: 今、血糖値を測ります。

english: Your blood sugar is higher than the target.
transliteration: Kettōchi ga mokuhyō yori takai desu.
translation: 血糖値が目標より高いです。

english: Have you ever had low blood sugar?
transliteration: Kettōchi ga hikuku natta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 血糖値が低くなったことはありますか？

english: Do you get shaky or sweaty when your sugar is low?
transliteration: Kettōchi ga hikui toki, te ga furuetari ase o kaitari shimasu ka?
translation: 血糖値が低いとき、手が震えたり汗をかいたりしますか？

english: Do you feel dizzy or confused when your sugar is low?
transliteration: Kettōchi ga hikui toki, memai ya konran ga arimasu ka?
translation: 血糖値が低いとき、めまいや混乱がありますか？

english: Have you ever fainted because of low blood sugar?
transliteration: Kettōchi ga hikuku natte, ki o ushinatta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 血糖値が低くなって、気を失ったことはありますか？

english: What do you do when your blood sugar is low?
transliteration: Kettōchi ga hikui toki wa, dō shite imasu ka?
translation: 血糖値が低いときは、どうしていますか？

english: Do you carry something sugary with you?
transliteration: Satō no haitta mono o mochiaruite imasu ka?
translation: 砂糖の入ったものを持ち歩いていますか？

english: Have you had very high blood sugar recently?
transliteration: Saikin, kettōchi ga totemo takaku natta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 最近、血糖値がとても高くなったことはありますか？

english: Have you had nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain?
transliteration: Hakike ya ōto, i no itami wa arimasu ka?
translation: 吐き気や嘔吐、胃の痛みはありますか？

english: Are you breathing faster or deeper than usual?
transliteration: Itsumo yori kokyū ga hayakattari, fukakattari shimasu ka?
translation: いつもより呼吸が速かったり、深かったりしますか？

english: Have you ever been hospitalized for diabetic ketoacidosis?
transliteration: Tōnyōbyōsei ketoashidōshisu de nyūin shita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 糖尿病性ケトアシドーシスで入院したことはありますか？

english: What medicines do you take for diabetes?
transliteration: Tōnyōbyō no tame ni, donna kusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 糖尿病のために、どんな薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take diabetes tablets?
transliteration: Tōnyōbyō no nomigusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 糖尿病の飲み薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you use insulin?
transliteration: Insurin o tsukatte imasu ka?
translation: インスリンを使っていますか？

english: How many units of insulin do you take?
transliteration: Insurin o nan-tan'i tsukatte imasu ka?
translation: インスリンを何単位使っていますか？

english: When do you take your insulin?
transliteration: Itsu insurin o tsukatte imasu ka?
translation: いつインスリンを使っていますか？

english: Did you take your insulin today?
transliteration: Kyō wa insurin o tsukaimashita ka?
translation: 今日はインスリンを使いましたか？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: Saikin, kusuri o nomi wasuretari tsukai wasuretari shita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 最近、薬を飲み忘れたり使い忘れたりしたことはありますか？

english: Do you use an insulin pen or pump?
transliteration: Insurin pen ka ponpu o tsukatte imasu ka?
translation: インスリンペンかポンプを使っていますか？

english: Where do you inject your insulin?
transliteration: Insurin wa doko ni chūsha shite imasu ka?
translation: インスリンはどこに注射していますか？

english: Do you rotate your injection sites?
transliteration: Chūsha suru basho o maikai kaete imasu ka?
translation: 注射する場所を毎回変えていますか？

english: Have you had side effects from your medicines?
transliteration: Kusuri no fukusayō wa arimashita ka?
translation: 薬の副作用はありましたか？

english: Would you like me to show you how to inject insulin?
transliteration: Insurin no chūsha no shikata o omise shimashō ka?
translation: インスリンの注射のしかたをお見せしましょうか？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling in your feet?
transliteration: Ashi ni shびれ ya chikuchiku suru kanji wa arimasu ka?
translation: 足にしびれやチクチクする感じはありますか？

english: Do you have burning pain in your feet?
transliteration: Ashi ni yakeru yō na itami wa arimasu ka?
translation: 足に焼けるような痛みはありますか？

english: Have you noticed any sores on your feet?
transliteration: Ashi ni kizu ga dekite iru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 足に傷ができていることに気づきましたか？

english: Do you check your feet every day?
transliteration: Mainichi, ashi o kakunin shite imasu ka?
translation: 毎日、足を確認していますか？

english: Have you had a diabetic eye examination?
transliteration: Tōnyōbyō no ganka kenshin o uketa koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 糖尿病の眼科検診を受けたことはありますか？

english: Has diabetes affected your kidneys?
transliteration: Tōnyōbyō de jinzō ni eikyō ga dete imasu ka?
translation: 糖尿病で腎臓に影響が出ていますか？

english: Have you had a heart attack or stroke?
transliteration: Shinzō hossa ya nōsottschū o okoshita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 心臓発作や脳卒中を起こしたことはありますか？

english: I am going to check the feeling in your feet.
transliteration: Ashi no kankaku o kakunin shimasu.
translation: 足の感覚を確認します。

english: Can you feel this on your toes?
transliteration: Tsumasaki ni furete iru no ga wakarimasu ka?
translation: つま先に触れているのがわかりますか？

english: Have you ever had a thyroid problem?
transliteration: Kōjōsen no byōki o shita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 甲状腺の病気をしたことはありますか？

english: Do you have an underactive thyroid?
transliteration: Kōjōsen no hataraki ga teika shite imasu ka?
translation: 甲状腺の働きが低下していますか？

english: Do you have an overactive thyroid?
transliteration: Kōjōsen no hataraki ga kappatsu sugimasu ka?
translation: 甲状腺の働きが活発すぎますか？

english: Do you feel unusually cold?
transliteration: Itsumo yori samuku kanjimasu ka?
translation: いつもより寒く感じますか？

english: Do you feel unusually hot or sweaty?
transliteration: Itsumo yori atsuku kanjitari, ase o kaitari shimasu ka?
translation: いつもより暑く感じたり、汗をかいたりしますか？

english: Have you noticed your heart racing?
transliteration: Shinzō ga dokidoki suru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 心臓がドキドキすることに気づきましたか？

english: Have you noticed shaking in your hands?
transliteration: Te ga furueru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 手が震えることに気づきましたか？

english: Have you been constipated?
transliteration: Benpi ni narimashita ka?
translation: 便秘になりましたか？

english: Have you been having frequent bowel movements?
transliteration: Haiben no kaisū ga fuete imasu ka?
translation: 排便の回数が増えていますか？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your neck?
transliteration: Kubi ga harete iru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 首が腫れていることに気づきましたか？

english: Is it difficult to swallow?
transliteration: Nomikomi nikui desu ka?
translation: 飲み込みにくいですか？

english: Has your voice become hoarse?
transliteration: Koe ga kasureru yō ni narimashita ka?
translation: 声がかすれるようになりましたか？

english: Do you take thyroid medication?
transliteration: Kōjōsen no kusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 甲状腺の薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Have you had thyroid surgery or radioactive iodine treatment?
transliteration: Kōjōsen no shujutsu ya hōshasei yōso no chiryō o uketa koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 甲状腺の手術や放射性ヨウ素の治療を受けたことはありますか？

english: Has your weight changed recently?
transliteration: Saikin, taijū ni henka wa arimashita ka?
translation: 最近、体重に変化はありましたか？

english: How much weight have you gained or lost?
transliteration: Taijū wa dono kurai fuetari herattari shimashita ka?
translation: 体重はどのくらい増えたり減ったりしましたか？

english: Has your appetite changed?
transliteration: Shokuyoku ni henka wa arimashita ka?
translation: 食欲に変化はありましたか？

english: What do you usually eat in a day?
transliteration: Fudan, ichinichi ni donna mono o tabete imasu ka?
translation: 普段、1日にどんなものを食べていますか？

english: How often do you exercise?
transliteration: Dono kurai no hindo de undō shimasu ka?
translation: どのくらいの頻度で運動しますか？

english: Do you drink sugary drinks?
transliteration: Satō no haitta nomimono o nomimasu ka?
translation: 砂糖の入った飲み物を飲みますか？

english: Have you tried making changes to your diet?
transliteration: Shokuji o kaete mita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 食事を変えてみたことはありますか？

english: Would you like help with weight management?
transliteration: Taijū kanri ni tsuite, sapōto ga hitsuyō desu ka?
translation: 体重管理について、サポートが必要ですか？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you ever broken a bone after a minor fall?
transliteration: Karuku koronda dake de kossetsu shita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 軽く転んだだけで骨折したことはありますか？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been told you have osteoporosis?
transliteration: Kotsusoshōshō da to iwareta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 骨粗しょう症だと言われたことはありますか？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had a bone density scan?
transliteration: Kotsumitsudo kensa o uketa koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 骨密度検査を受けたことはありますか？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you take calcium or vitamin D?
transliteration: Karushiumu ya bitamin D o totte imasu ka?
translation: カルシウムやビタミンDを摂っていますか？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had kidney stones?
transliteration: Jinzō kesseki ga dekita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 腎臓結石ができたことはありますか？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have muscle cramps or spasms?
transliteration: Kinniku ga tsuttari, keiren shitari shimasu ka?
translation: 筋肉がつったり、けいれんしたりしますか？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have tingling around your mouth or fingers?
transliteration: Kuchi no mawari ya yubi ni chikuchiku suru kanji wa arimasu ka?
translation: 口の周りや指にチクチクする感じはありますか？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been diagnosed with a parathyroid problem?
transliteration: Fukukōjōsen no byōki to shindan sareta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 副甲状腺の病気と診断されたことはありますか？

english: Have you ever had a problem with your adrenal glands?
transliteration: Fukujin no byōki o shita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 副腎の病気をしたことはありますか？

english: Do you take steroid medicines such as prednisone?
transliteration: Puredonizon nado no suteroido-yaku o nonde imasu ka?
translation: プレドニゾンなどのステロイド薬を飲んでいますか？

english: How long have you been taking steroids?
transliteration: Dono kurai no kikan, suteroido o tsukatte imasu ka?
translation: どのくらいの期間、ステロイドを使っていますか？

english: Have you recently stopped taking steroids?
transliteration: Saikin, suteroido o tsukau no o yamemashita ka?
translation: 最近、ステロイドを使うのをやめましたか？

english: Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
transliteration: Tachiagaru toki ni memai ga shimasu ka?
translation: 立ち上がるときにめまいがしますか？

english: Have you noticed darker patches of skin?
transliteration: Hifu no iro ga koku natta bubun ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 皮膚の色が濃くなった部分に気づきましたか？

english: Do you crave salty foods?
transliteration: Shiokarai mono ga hoshiku narimasu ka?
translation: 塩辛いものが欲しくなりますか？

english: Have you noticed easy bruising or purple stretch marks?
transliteration: Aza ga dekiyasuku nattari, murasaki-iro no nikuwari ga dekitari shimashita ka?
translation: あざができやすくなったり、紫色の肉割れができたりしましたか？

english: Do you have an emergency steroid plan?
transliteration: Kinkyūji no suteroido shiyō keikaku ga arimasu ka?
translation: 緊急時のステロイド使用計画がありますか？

english: Have you had persistent headaches or changes in vision?
transliteration: Zutsū ga tsuzuitari, miekata ni henka ga attari shimashita ka?
translation: 頭痛が続いたり、見え方に変化があったりしましたか？

english: Have your periods become irregular or stopped?
transliteration: Seiri ga fukisoku ni nattari, tomattari shimashita ka?
translation: 生理が不規則になったり、止まったりしましたか？

english: Have you noticed unexpected milk discharge from your breasts?
transliteration: Mune kara, ninshin ya junyū to wa kankei naku bonyū no yō na mono ga deru koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 胸から、妊娠や授乳とは関係なく母乳のようなものが出ることに気づきましたか？

english: Have you noticed changes in sexual desire?
transliteration: Seiyoku ni henka ga arimashita ka?
translation: 性欲に変化がありましたか？

english: Have you had problems with erections?
transliteration: Bokki ni mondai ga arimashita ka?
translation: 勃起に問題がありましたか？

english: Have you noticed increased facial or body hair?
transliteration: Kao ya karada no ke ga fueta koto ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 顔や体の毛が増えたことに気づきましたか？

english: Have you noticed unusual acne or hair loss?
transliteration: Itsumo to chigau nikibi ya nukemō ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: いつもと違うニキビや抜け毛に気づきましたか？

english: Have you had difficulty becoming pregnant?
transliteration: Ninshin shinikui to kanjita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 妊娠しにくいと感じたことはありますか？

english: Are you taking any hormone treatment?
transliteration: Horumon chiryō o ukete imasu ka?
translation: ホルモン治療を受けていますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have diabetes?
transliteration: Gokazoku ni tōnyōbyō no kata wa imasu ka?
translation: ご家族に糖尿病の方はいますか？

english: Does anyone in your family have thyroid disease?
transliteration: Gokazoku ni kōjōsen no byōki no kata wa imasu ka?
translation: ご家族に甲状腺の病気の方はいますか？

english: Do you have high blood pressure or high cholesterol?
transliteration: Kōketsuatsu ya koresuterōru-chi ga takai jōtai desu ka?
translation: 高血圧やコレステロール値が高い状態ですか？

english: Do you have any kidney or heart problems?
transliteration: Jinzō ya shinzō ni mondai ga arimasu ka?
translation: 腎臓や心臓に問題がありますか？

english: Have you had any surgery?
transliteration: Shujutsu o uketa koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 手術を受けたことはありますか？

english: Are you pregnant or planning a pregnancy?
transliteration: Ninshin-chū desu ka, mata wa ninshin o yotei shite imasu ka?
translation: 妊娠中ですか、または妊娠を予定していますか？

english: Do you smoke or drink alcohol?
transliteration: Tabako o suttari, osake o nondari shimasu ka?
translation: たばこを吸ったり、お酒を飲んだりしますか？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: Kusuri no arerugī wa arimasu ka?
translation: 薬のアレルギーはありますか？

english: I am going to measure your height and weight.
transliteration: Shinchō to taijū o hakarimasu.
translation: 身長と体重を測ります。

english: I am going to check your blood pressure.
transliteration: Ketsuatsu o hakarimasu.
translation: 血圧を測ります。

english: Please hold your hands out in front of you.
transliteration: Ryōte o mae ni dashite kudasai.
translation: 両手を前に出してください。

english: I am checking whether your hands are shaking.
transliteration: Te ga furuete iru ka kakunin shite imasu.
translation: 手が震えているか確認しています。

english: Please tilt your head back slightly.
transliteration: Atama o sukoshi ushiro ni katamukete kudasai.
translation: 頭を少し後ろに傾けてください。

english: Please swallow while I examine your neck.
transliteration: Kubi o shinsatsu shite iru aida ni, tsuba o nomikonde kudasai.
translation: 首を診察している間に、つばを飲み込んでください。

english: I am going to feel your thyroid gland.
transliteration: Kōjōsen ni furete kakunin shimasu.
translation: 甲状腺に触れて確認します。

english: Please follow my finger with your eyes.
transliteration: Me de watashi no yubi o otte kudasai.
translation: 目で私の指を追ってください。

english: I am going to examine your feet for sores.
transliteration: Ashi ni kizu ga nai ka shinsatsu shimasu.
translation: 足に傷がないか診察します。

english: Please tell me when you feel this touch.
transliteration: Kono kan shoku ga wakattara oshiete kudasai.
translation: この感触がわかったら教えてください。

english: I am going to check your reflexes.
transliteration: Hansha o kakunin shimasu.
translation: 反射を確認します。

english: We need a blood test to check your thyroid hormones.
transliteration: Kōjōsen horumon o shiraberu tame ni, ketsueki kensa ga hitsuyō desu.
translation: 甲状腺ホルモンを調べるために、血液検査が必要です。

english: We will check your HbA1c to assess your average blood sugar.
transliteration: Heikinteki na kettōchi o shiraberu tame ni, HbA1c o hakarimasu.
translation: 平均的な血糖値を調べるために、HbA1cを測ります。

english: We need to check your kidney function.
transliteration: Jinzō no kinō o shiraberu hitsuyō ga arimasu.
translation: 腎臓の機能を調べる必要があります。

english: We will check your cholesterol.
transliteration: Koresuterōru-chi o shirabemasu.
translation: コレステロール値を調べます。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: Nyō kentai ga hitsuyō desu.
translation: 尿検体が必要です。

english: You may need an ultrasound of your thyroid.
transliteration: Kōjōsen no chōonpa kensa ga hitsuyō ni naru kamo shiremasen.
translation: 甲状腺の超音波検査が必要になるかもしれません。

english: We may need a bone density scan.
transliteration: Kotsu-mitsudo kensa ga hitsuyō ni naru kamoshiremasen.
translation: 骨密度検査が必要になるかもしれません。

english: Please follow the fasting instructions for this test.
transliteration: Kono kensa no mae wa, shiji-dōri shokuji o hikaete kudasai.
translation: この検査の前は、指示どおり食事を控えてください。

english: We will review your medications together.
transliteration: Kusuri o issho ni kakunin shimasu.
translation: 薬を一緒に確認します。

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: Shohō sareta tōri ni kono kusuri o nonde kudasai.
translation: 処方されたとおりにこの薬を飲んでください。

english: Do not change your insulin dose without guidance.
transliteration: Shiji o ukezu ni insurin no ryō o kaenaide kudasai.
translation: 指示を受けずにインスリンの量を変えないでください。

english: Do not stop long-term steroids suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: Ishi ni sōdan sezu ni, chōkikan tsukatte iru suteroido-yaku o kyū ni yamenaide kudasai.
translation: 医師に相談せずに、長期間使っているステロイド薬を急にやめないでください。

english: We can arrange a visit with a diabetes educator.
transliteration: Tōnyōbyō ryōyō shidōshi to no mendan o tehai dekimasu.
translation: 糖尿病療養指導士との面談を手配できます。

english: Please bring your medicines and glucose readings next time.
transliteration: Jikai wa kusuri to kettōchi no kiroku o motte kite kudasai.
translation: 次回は薬と血糖値の記録を持ってきてください。

english: We will discuss a plan that works for you.
transliteration: Anata ni atta keikaku ni tsuite hanashiaimasu.
translation: あなたに合った計画について話し合います。

english: Are you very drowsy or confused?
transliteration: Hidoku nemukattari, atama ga konran shitari shite imasu ka?
translation: ひどく眠かったり、頭が混乱したりしていますか？

english: Are you vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: Haite shimai, suibun o totte mo hakazu ni irarenai jōtai desu ka?
translation: 吐いてしまい、水分を取っても吐かずにいられない状態ですか？

english: Do you have severe weakness or fainting?
transliteration: Hidoku chikara ga hairanakattari, ki o ushinattari shite imasu ka?
translation: ひどく力が入らなかったり、気を失ったりしていますか？

english: Seek urgent medical help if you become confused or faint.
transliteration: Atama ga konran shitari, ki o ushinattari shita baai wa, sugu ni iryō kikan o jushin shite kudasai.
translation: 頭が混乱したり、気を失ったりした場合は、すぐに医療機関を受診してください。

english: When is your next follow-up appointment?
transliteration: Tsugi no keika kansatsu no yoyaku wa itsu desu ka?
translation: 次の経過観察の予約はいつですか？

english: Do you have any questions about the plan?
transliteration: Keikaku ni tsuite nanika shitsumon wa arimasu ka?
translation: 計画について何か質問はありますか？

english: What would you like help with today?
transliteration: Kyō wa dono yō na koto de otetsudai dekimasu ka?
translation: 今日はどのようなことでお手伝いできますか？

english: How have you been feeling lately?
transliteration: Saikin, kibun wa ikaga desu ka?
translation: 最近、気分はいかがですか？

english: Is it okay if I ask some personal questions?
transliteration: Kojinteki na koto o ikutsuka shitsumon shite mo yoroshii desu ka?
translation: 個人的なことをいくつか質問してもよろしいですか？

english: You can tell me if a question feels uncomfortable.
transliteration: Kotaenikui shitsumon ga areba, oshiete kudasai.
translation: 答えにくい質問があれば、教えてください。

english: I will listen without judging you.
transliteration: Anata o hihan sezu ni ohanashi o kikimasu.
translation: あなたを批判せずにお話を聞きます。

english: Would you prefer to speak with an interpreter?
transliteration: Tsūyaku no kata to hanasu koto o go kibō desu ka?
translation: 通訳の方と話すことをご希望ですか？

english: I will explain the limits of confidentiality.
transliteration: Himitsu o mamoru koto ni dono yō na genkai ga aru ka, go setsumei shimasu.
translation: 秘密を守ることにどのような限界があるか、ご説明します。

english: Is there anything important you want me to know?
transliteration: Watashi ni shitte oite hoshii taisetsu na koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 私に知っておいてほしい大切なことはありますか？

english: When did these feelings or symptoms begin?
transliteration: Kono kimochi ya shōjō wa itsu hajimarimashita ka?
translation: この気持ちや症状はいつ始まりましたか？

english: Did anything happen around the time they started?
transliteration: Hajimatta koro ni nanika arimashita ka?
translation: 始まった頃に何かありましたか？

english: Have things been getting better or worse?
transliteration: Yoku natte imasu ka, soretomo waruku natte imasu ka?
translation: 良くなっていますか、それとも悪くなっていますか？

english: How often do you feel this way?
transliteration: Dono kurai no hin-do de kono yō ni kanjimasu ka?
translation: どのくらいの頻度でこのように感じますか？

english: How much is this affecting your daily life?
transliteration: Nichijō seikatsu ni dono kurai eikyō shite imasu ka?
translation: 日常生活にどのくらい影響していますか？

english: Are you able to go to work or school?
transliteration: Shigoto ya gakkō ni ikete imasu ka?
translation: 仕事や学校に行けていますか？

english: Are you managing your usual responsibilities?
transliteration: Itsumo no yakuwari ya sekinin o hatasete imasu ka?
translation: いつもの役割や責任を果たせていますか？

english: What has helped you cope so far?
transliteration: Kore made, taisho suru no ni yakudatta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: これまで、対処するのに役立ったことはありますか？

english: Have you been feeling sad or down?
transliteration: Kanashii kimochi ya ochikonda kimochi ga tsuzuite imasu ka?
translation: 悲しい気持ちや落ち込んだ気持ちが続いていますか？

english: Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
transliteration: Izen wa tanoshimete ita koto ni kyōmi ga nakunarimashita ka?
translation: 以前は楽しめていたことに興味がなくなりましたか？

english: Do you feel hopeless about the future?
transliteration: Shōrai ni kibō ga motenai to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 将来に希望が持てないと感じますか？

english: Do you feel guilty or worthless?
transliteration: Zaiakukan o kanjitari, jibun ni wa kachi ga nai to omottari shimasu ka?
translation: 罪悪感を感じたり、自分には価値がないと思ったりしますか？

english: Do you cry more often than usual?
transliteration: Itsumo yori yoku nakimasu ka?
translation: いつもよりよく泣きますか？

english: Has your energy been low?
transliteration: Enerugī ga denai to kanjimasu ka?
translation: エネルギーが出ないと感じますか？

english: Is it hard to concentrate or make decisions?
transliteration: Shūchū shitari, ketsudan shitari suru no ga muzukashii desu ka?
translation: 集中したり、決断したりするのが難しいですか？

english: Have you noticed changes in your appetite?
transliteration: Shokuyoku ni henka ga arimashita ka?
translation: 食欲に変化がありましたか？

english: Have you noticed any changes in your weight?
transliteration: Taijū ni henka ga arimashita ka?
translation: 体重に変化がありましたか？

english: Do you often feel worried or anxious?
transliteration: Shinpai shitari, fuan ni nattari suru koto ga yoku arimasu ka?
translation: 心配したり、不安になったりすることがよくありますか？

english: Is it difficult to control your worries?
transliteration: Shinpai o osaeru no ga muzukashii desu ka?
translation: 心配を抑えるのが難しいですか？

english: Do you feel restless or on edge?
transliteration: Sowasowa shitari, ochitsukanakattari shimasu ka?
translation: そわそわしたり、落ち着かなかったりしますか？

english: Do you have sudden episodes of intense fear?
transliteration: Totsuzen, tsuyoi kyōfu o kanjiru koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 突然、強い恐怖を感じることがありますか？

english: During these episodes, does your heart race?
transliteration: Sono toki, shinzō ga dokidoki shimasu ka?
translation: そのとき、心臓がどきどきしますか？

english: Do you feel short of breath when anxious?
transliteration: Fuan ni naru to, ikigurushiku narimasu ka?
translation: 不安になると、息苦しくなりますか？

english: Do you avoid places because you fear having a panic attack?
transliteration: Panikku hossa ga okiru no ga kowakute, basho o sakeru koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: パニック発作が起きるのが怖くて、場所を避けることがありますか？

english: Do unwanted thoughts keep coming into your mind?
transliteration: Nozonde inai kangae ga, nando mo atama ni ukabimasu ka?
translation: 望んでいない考えが、何度も頭に浮かびますか？

english: Do you feel you must repeat certain actions?
transliteration: Tokutei no kōdō o kurikaesazu ni wa irarenai to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 特定の行動を繰り返さずにはいられないと感じますか？

english: How many hours do you sleep each night?
transliteration: Maiban, nan-jikan kurai nemurimasu ka?
translation: 毎晩、何時間くらい眠りますか？

english: Is it difficult to fall asleep?
transliteration: Netsuku no ga muzukashii desu ka?
translation: 寝つくのが難しいですか？

english: Do you wake up often during the night?
transliteration: Yonaka ni nando mo me ga samemasu ka?
translation: 夜中に何度も目が覚めますか？

english: Do you wake up earlier than you want to?
transliteration: Okitai jikan yori hayaku me ga samemasu ka?
translation: 起きたい時間より早く目が覚めますか？

english: Do you feel rested in the morning?
transliteration: Asa, yoku nemureta to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 朝、よく眠れたと感じますか？

english: Do you have nightmares?
transliteration: Akumu o mimasu ka?
translation: 悪夢を見ますか？

english: Have you been sleeping much more than usual?
transliteration: Itsumo yori zutto nagaku nemutte imasu ka?
translation: いつもよりずっと長く眠っていますか？

english: Do you feel tired during the day?
transliteration: Nitchū, tsukare o kanjimasu ka?
translation: 日中、疲れを感じますか？

english: Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or excited?
transliteration: Itsumo to chigatte, totemo genki dattari kibun ga takamattari shita jiki wa arimasu ka?
translation: いつもと違って、とても元気だったり気分が高まったりした時期はありますか？

english: Have you needed much less sleep without feeling tired?
transliteration: Tsukare o kanjizu ni, suimin jikan ga kanari sukunakute mo daijōbu datta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 疲れを感じずに、睡眠時間がかなり少なくても大丈夫だったことはありますか？

english: Have others said you were talking unusually fast?
transliteration: Hito kara, itsumo to chigatte hanasu no ga totemo hayai to iwareta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 人から、いつもと違って話すのがとても速いと言われたことがありますか？

english: Have your thoughts been racing?
transliteration: Kangae ga tsugitsugi to ukande tomaranai koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 考えが次々と浮かんで止まらないことがありますか？

english: Have you felt unusually confident or powerful?
transliteration: Itsumo to chigatte, jibun ni tsuyoi jishin ga attari, ōkina chikara ga aru to kanjitari shimashita ka?
translation: いつもと違って、自分に強い自信があったり、大きな力があると感じたりしましたか？

english: Have you spent more money than you intended?
transliteration: Tsukau tsumori datta kingaku yori ōku tsukatta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 使うつもりだった金額より多く使ったことがありますか？

english: Have you taken unusual risks during these periods?
transliteration: Kōshita jiki ni, itsumo to chigau kiken na kōdō o totta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: こうした時期に、いつもと違う危険な行動を取ったことがありますか？

english: How long did these periods last?
transliteration: Kōshita jiki wa dono kurai tsuzukimashita ka?
translation: こうした時期はどのくらい続きましたか？

english: Have you heard voices that others cannot hear?
transliteration: Hoka no hito ni wa kikoenai koe ga kikoeta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: ほかの人には聞こえない声が聞こえたことがありますか？

english: Have you seen things that others cannot see?
transliteration: Hoka no hito ni wa mienai mono ga mieta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: ほかの人には見えないものが見えたことがありますか？

english: Do you feel that someone is watching or following you?
transliteration: Dareka ni mihirararetari, ato o tsukeraretari shite iru to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 誰かに見張られたり、後をつけられたりしていると感じますか？

english: Do you feel that someone wants to harm you?
transliteration: Dareka ga anata ni kigai o kuwaeyō to shite iru to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 誰かがあなたに危害を加えようとしていると感じますか？

english: Do you feel your thoughts are being controlled?
transliteration: Jibun no kangae ga dareka ni ayatsurarete iru to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 自分の考えが誰かに操られていると感じますか？

english: Do the voices ever tell you to do something?
transliteration: Koe ga nanika o suru yō ni shiji suru koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 声が何かをするように指示することがありますか？

english: What do you think these experiences mean?
transliteration: Kōshita taiken ni wa, dono yō na imi ga aru to omoimasu ka?
translation: こうした体験には、どのような意味があると思いますか？

english: Do these experiences frighten you?
transliteration: Kōshita taiken o kowai to kanjimasu ka?
translation: こうした体験を怖いと感じますか？

english: Sometimes when people feel overwhelmed, they think about death. Has that happened to you?
transliteration: Kimochi ga ippai ippai ni naru to, shi ni tsuite kangaeru koto ga arimasu. Anata ni mo sō iu koto ga arimashita ka?
translation: 気持ちがいっぱいいっぱいになると、死について考えることがあります。あなたにもそういうことがありましたか？

english: Have you wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
transliteration: Nemuri ni tsuite, sono mama me ga samenakereba ii no ni to omotta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 眠りについて、そのまま目が覚めなければいいのにと思ったことがありますか？

english: Have you had thoughts of ending your life?
transliteration: Jibun no inochi o tatsu koto o kangaeta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 自分の命を絶つことを考えたことがありますか？

english: Are you having those thoughts right now?
transliteration: Ima, sono yō na kangae ga arimasu ka?
translation: 今、そのような考えがありますか？

english: Have you thought about how you might do it?
transliteration: Dono yō ni jikkō suru ka kangaeta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: どのように実行するか考えたことがありますか？

english: Have you made a plan to end your life?
transliteration: Jibun no inochi o tatsu keikaku o tateta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 自分の命を絶つ計画を立てたことがありますか？

english: Do you have access to anything you might use to hurt yourself?
transliteration: Jibun o kizutsukeru tame ni tsukau kamoshirenai mono o, te ni dekiru jōtai desu ka?
translation: 自分を傷つけるために使うかもしれないものを、手にできる状態ですか？

english: Have you ever tried to end your life before?
transliteration: Izen, jibun no inochi o tatō to shita koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 以前、自分の命を絶とうとしたことがありますか？

english: Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose?
transliteration: Jibun o kizutsukeru tsumori de, jissai ni kizutsuketa koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 自分を傷つけるつもりで、実際に傷つけたことがありますか？

english: What has helped you stay safe so far?
transliteration: Kore made anzen o tamotsu no ni yakudatta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: これまで安全を保つのに役立ったことはありますか？

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: Renraku shite mo yoi, shinrai dekiru hito wa imasu ka?
translation: 連絡してもよい、信頼できる人はいますか？

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: Anata no anzen o shinpai shite imasu. Anzen o tamoteru yō, otetsudai shitai desu.
translation: あなたの安全を心配しています。安全を保てるよう、お手伝いしたいです。

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
transliteration: Ima sunde iru basho de anzen da to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 今住んでいる場所で安全だと感じますか？

english: Has anyone threatened or hurt you?
transliteration: Dareka ni odosaretari, kizutsukeraretari shita koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 誰かに脅されたり、傷つけられたりしたことがありますか？

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?
transliteration: Ie ni iru toki, dareka o kowai to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 家にいるとき、誰かを怖いと感じますか？

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: Dareka o kizutsuketai to omotta koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 誰かを傷つけたいと思ったことがありますか？

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?
transliteration: Kizutsuketai to omotte iru tokutei no hito wa imasu ka?
translation: 傷つけたいと思っている特定の人はいますか？

english: Do you have a plan to hurt anyone?
transliteration: Dareka o kizutsukeru keikaku ga arimasu ka?
translation: 誰かを傷つける計画がありますか？

english: Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?
transliteration: Ie ni kodomo ya, hoka ni tokubetsu na hairyo ga hitsuyō na hito wa imasu ka?
translation: 家に子どもや、ほかに特別な配慮が必要な人はいますか？

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?
transliteration: Kowai omoi o shitari, kokoro ni fukai kizu o ou yō na taiken o shita koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 怖い思いをしたり、心に深い傷を負うような体験をしたことがありますか？

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: Hanasu junbi ga dekiru made, kuwashii koto o hanasu hitsuyō wa arimasen.
translation: 話す準備ができるまで、詳しいことを話す必要はありません。

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
transliteration: Sono taiken no kioku ga, omoigakezu yomigaeru koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: その体験の記憶が、思いがけずよみがえることがありますか？

english: Do you have nightmares about what happened?
transliteration: Okita koto ni tsuite akumu o miru koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 起きたことについて悪夢を見ることがありますか？

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?
transliteration: Okita koto o omoidasaseru mono o sakete imasu ka?
translation: 起きたことを思い出させるものを避けていますか？

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?
transliteration: Itsumo keikai shite itari, anzen de nai to kanjitari shimasu ka?
translation: いつも警戒していたり、安全でないと感じたりしますか？

english: Do you sometimes feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings?
transliteration: Jibun jishin ya mawari no jōkyō kara kirihanasa reta yō ni kanjiru koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 自分自身や周りの状況から切り離されたように感じることがありますか？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: Osake o nomimasu ka?
translation: お酒を飲みますか？

english: How often and how much do you drink?
transliteration: Dono kurai no hin do de, dore kurai osake o nomimasu ka?
translation: どのくらいの頻度で、どれくらいお酒を飲みますか？

english: Have you wanted to cut down on drinking?
transliteration: Osake o nomu ryo o herashitai to omotta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: お酒を飲む量を減らしたいと思ったことはありますか？

english: Has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?
transliteration: Anata no osake no nomikata o shinpai shite iru hito wa imasu ka?
translation: あなたのお酒の飲み方を心配している人はいますか？

english: Do you use cannabis?
transliteration: Taima o tsukatte imasu ka?
translation: 大麻を使っていますか？

english: Do you use cocaine, opioids, or other drugs?
transliteration: Kokain, opioido, mata wa hoka no yakubutsu o tsukatte imasu ka?
translation: コカイン、オピオイド、またはほかの薬物を使っていますか？

english: Have you ever injected drugs?
transliteration: Yakubutsu o chusha shita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 薬物を注射したことはありますか？

english: When did you last use alcohol or other substances?
transliteration: Saigo ni osake ya hoka no yakubutsu o tsukatta no wa itsu desu ka?
translation: 最後にお酒やほかの薬物を使ったのはいつですか？

english: Do you feel shaky or unwell when you stop using them?
transliteration: Sorera o yameru to, karada ga furueri guai ga waruku nattari shimasu ka?
translation: それらをやめると、体が震えたり具合が悪くなったりしますか？

english: Have you ever had a seizure during withdrawal?
transliteration: Yakubutsu o yameta toki ni, keiren hassho o okoshita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 薬物をやめたときに、けいれん発作を起こしたことはありますか？

english: Would you like support to reduce or stop using substances?
transliteration: Yakubutsu no shiyo o herashitari, yametari suru tame no shien o uketai desu ka?
translation: 薬物の使用を減らしたり、やめたりするための支援を受けたいですか？

english: How do you feel about your eating habits?
transliteration: Tabekata ni tsuite, dono yo ni kanjite imasu ka?
translation: 食べ方について、どのように感じていますか？

english: Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?
transliteration: Taiju ya taikei no koto o yoku shinpai shimasu ka?
translation: 体重や体型のことをよく心配しますか？

english: Have you been skipping meals or restricting food?
transliteration: Shokuji o nuitari, taberu ryo o seigen shitari shite imasu ka?
translation: 食事を抜いたり、食べる量を制限したりしていますか？

english: Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?
transliteration: Tabe hajimeru to, yamerarenai to kanjiru koto ga arimasu ka?
translation: 食べ始めると、やめられないと感じることがありますか？

english: Have you made yourself vomit after eating?
transliteration: Tabeta ato ni, jibun de haita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 食べた後に、自分で吐いたことはありますか？

english: Have you been exercising to compensate for eating?
transliteration: Tabeta bun o shohi suru tame ni undo shite imasu ka?
translation: 食べた分を消費するために運動していますか？

english: Have you had trouble paying attention?
transliteration: Chui o shuuchu suru no ga muzukashii koto wa arimashita ka?
translation: 注意を集中するのが難しいことはありましたか？

english: Do you often forget appointments or tasks?
transliteration: Yakusoku ya yoji o yoku wasuremasu ka?
translation: 約束や用事をよく忘れますか？

english: Have you noticed changes in your memory?
transliteration: Kioku ni henka ga atta to kanjimasu ka?
translation: 記憶に変化があったと感じますか？

english: Do you find it difficult to organize tasks?
transliteration: Monogoto o dandori yoku susumeru no ga muzukashii desu ka?
translation: 物事を段取りよく進めるのが難しいですか？

english: Have you been feeling confused?
transliteration: Konran shitari, atama ga bonyari shitari shite imasu ka?
translation: 混乱したり、頭がぼんやりしたりしていますか？

english: Has anyone noticed a change in your behaviour?
transliteration: Anata no kodo ni henka ga atta to kizuita hito wa imasu ka?
translation: あなたの行動に変化があったと気づいた人はいますか？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: Furuneemu o oshiete itadakemasu ka?
translation: フルネームを教えていただけますか？

english: Can you tell me today’s date?
transliteration: Kyo wa nangatsu nannichi ka oshiete itadakemasu ka?
translation: 今日は何月何日か教えていただけますか？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: Ima koko ga doko ka, oshiete itadakemasu ka?
translation: 今ここがどこか、教えていただけますか？

english: I will say three words; please repeat them.
transliteration: Kore kara mittsu no kotoba o iimasu node, kurikaeshite kudasai.
translation: これから3つの言葉を言いますので、繰り返してください。

english: Please try to remember those words for later.
transliteration: Ato de omoidaseru yo ni, kono kotoba o oboete oite kudasai.
translation: 後で思い出せるように、この言葉を覚えておいてください。

english: Can you tell me those three words now?
transliteration: Ima, sakihodo no mittsu no kotoba o iemasu ka?
translation: 今、先ほどの3つの言葉を言えますか？

english: Can you spell a word backwards?
transliteration: Aru kotoba o gyaku kara tsuzuru koto wa dekimasu ka?
translation: ある言葉を逆からつづることはできますか？

english: What do you think is causing these difficulties?
transliteration: Kono yo na komarigoto no gen'in wa nan da to omoimasu ka?
translation: このような困りごとの原因は何だと思いますか？

english: How would you describe your mood today?
transliteration: Kyo no kibun o dono yo ni arawashimasu ka?
translation: 今日の気分をどのように表しますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever seen a psychiatrist or counsellor?
transliteration: Kore made ni seishinkai ya kaunsera ni sodan shita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: これまでに精神科医やカウンセラーに相談したことはありますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health care?
transliteration: Kokoro no kenko no tame ni, nyuin shita koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 心の健康のために、入院したことはありますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Has anyone in your family had mental health difficulties?
transliteration: Gokazoku ni, kokoro no kenko de komatta koto ga aru kata wa imasu ka?
translation: ご家族に、心の健康で困ったことがある方はいますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Do you have any medical conditions?
transliteration: Nanika jibyo wa arimasu ka?
translation: 何か持病はありますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: Dare to issho ni kurashite imasu ka?
translation: 誰と一緒に暮らしていますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who can you turn to for support?
transliteration: Komatta toki, dare ni sodan dekimasu ka?
translation: 困ったとき、誰に相談できますか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you had recent financial or housing difficulties?
transliteration: Saikin, okane ya sumai no koto de komatta koto wa arimashita ka?
translation: 最近、お金や住まいのことで困ったことはありましたか？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Are your relationships causing you stress?
transliteration: Ningen kankei ga sutoresu no gen'in ni natte imasu ka?
translation: 人間関係がストレスの原因になっていますか？

english: What medicines are you taking now?
transliteration: Ima, dono yo na kusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 今、どのような薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take antidepressant medication?
transliteration: Koutsuyaku o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 抗うつ薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take medicine for anxiety?
transliteration: Fuan o osaeru kusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 不安を抑える薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take antipsychotic medication?
transliteration: Koseishinbyoyaku o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 抗精神病薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take a mood stabilizer?
transliteration: Kibun o antei saseru kusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 気分を安定させる薬を飲んでいますか？

english: Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
transliteration: Suimin'yaku ya benzojiaze-pin-kei no kusuri o nonde imasu ka?
translation: 睡眠薬やベンゾジアゼピン系の薬を飲んでいますか？

english: What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: Dono kurai no ryo o, dono kurai no hindo de nonde imasu ka?
translation: どのくらいの量を、どのくらいの頻度で飲んでいますか？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: Kono kusuri o nomihajimete dono kurai ni narimasu ka?
translation: この薬を飲み始めてどのくらいになりますか？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: Saikin, kusuri o nomiwasureta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 最近、薬を飲み忘れたことはありますか？

english: Has the medicine been helping?
transliteration: Kusuri wa kiite imasu ka?
translation: 薬は効いていますか？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: Nanika fukusayo ni kizukimashita ka?
translation: 何か副作用に気づきましたか？

english: Have you stopped any medication recently?
transliteration: Saikin, kusuri o yameta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 最近、薬をやめたことはありますか？

english: What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: Chiryo ni tsuite, dono yo na mokuhyo ga arimasu ka?
translation: 治療について、どのような目標がありますか？

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
transliteration: Shinri ryoho ya kaunseringu o ukete mitai desu ka?
translation: 心理療法やカウンセリングを受けてみたいですか？

english: We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: Kusuri no sentakushi ni tsuite, issho ni sodan dekimasu.
translation: 薬の選択肢について、一緒に相談できます。

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: Kusuri ni yotte wa, jubun ni kiku made ni suushuukan kakarimasu.
translation: 薬によっては、十分に効くまでに数週間かかります。

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: Kusuri o yameru mae ni, tanto no iryo jujisha ni sodan shite kudasai.
translation: 薬をやめる前に、担当の医療従事者に相談してください。

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: Shinrai dekiru gokazoku ni mo doseki shite moraitai desu ka?
translation: 信頼できるご家族にも同席してもらいたいですか？

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: Shojo ga akka shita toki ni do suru ka, issho ni keikaku o tateraremasu.
translation: 症状が悪化したときにどうするか、一緒に計画を立てられます。

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
transliteration: Chiryo ni tsuite, shinpai na koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 治療について、心配なことはありますか？

english: Do you feel safe going home today?
transliteration: Kyo wa anshin shite ie ni kaereso desu ka?
translation: 今日は安心して家に帰れそうですか？

english: Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: Mi no kiken o kanjita toki, dare ni denwa dekimasu ka?
translation: 身の危険を感じたとき、誰に電話できますか？

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: Jotai ga akka shite iru toki no chokō o issho ni kakunin dekimasu ka?
translation: 状態が悪化しているときの兆候を一緒に確認できますか？

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: Sashisematta kiken ga aru baai wa, kyukyu no tasuke o motomete kudasai.
translation: 差し迫った危険がある場合は、救急の助けを求めてください。

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: Jikai no shinsatsu o yoyaku dekimasu.
translation: 次回の診察を予約できます。

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: Chiiki no shien sabisu ni tsuite, joho o o-shiri ni naritai desu ka?
translation: 地域の支援サービスについて、情報をお知りになりたいですか？

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
transliteration: Hoka ni kikitai koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: ほかに聞きたいことはありますか？

english: I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: Shojo ni tsuite ikutsuka shitsumon shimasu.
translation: 症状についていくつか質問します。

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
transliteration: Shojo ga saisho ni hajimatta no wa itsu desu ka?
translation: 症状が最初に始まったのはいつですか？

english: Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: Shojo wa totsuzen hajimarimashita ka, soretomo jojo ni hajimarimashita ka?
translation: 症状は突然始まりましたか、それとも徐々に始まりましたか？

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: Shojo ga hajimatta toki, nani o shite imashita ka?
translation: 症状が始まったとき、何をしていましたか？

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: Shojo wa zutto tsuzuite imasu ka, soretomo detari kietari shimasu ka?
translation: 症状はずっと続いていますか、それとも出たり消えたりしますか？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: Shojo ga deru tabi ni, dono kurai tsuzukimasu ka?
translation: 症状が出るたびに、どのくらい続きますか？

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: Kore ga okoru no wa, ichinichi ni, mata wa isshuukan ni nankai kurai desu ka?
translation: これが起こるのは、1日に、または1週間に何回くらいですか？

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: Shojo wa yoku natte imasu ka, waruku natte imasu ka, soretomo kawarimasen ka?
translation: 症状は良くなっていますか、悪くなっていますか、それとも変わりませんか？

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: Izen ni mo onaji shojo ga deta koto wa arimasu ka?
translation: 以前にも同じ症状が出たことはありますか？

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: Shojo o yoku shitari waruku shitari suru mono wa arimasu ka?
translation: 症状を良くしたり悪くしたりするものはありますか？

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: Shinsatsu-chu ni guai ga waruku nattara, sugu ni oshiete kudasai.
translation: 診察中に具合が悪くなったら、すぐに教えてください。

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
transliteration: Karada no katagawa ni totsuzen chikara ga hairanaku narimashita ka?
translation: 体の片側に突然力が入らなくなりましたか？

english: Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
transliteration: Kao no katagawa ga totsuzen taresagarimashita ka?
translation: 顔の片側が突然垂れ下がりましたか？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
transliteration: Totsuzen, hanashinikuku narimashita ka?
translation: 突然、話しにくくなりましたか？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
transliteration: Totsuzen, hito no hanashi o rikai shinikuku narimashita ka?
translation: 突然、人の話を理解しにくくなりましたか？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision in one or both eyes?
transliteration: Katame mata wa ryome ga totsuzen mienaku narimashita ka?
translation: 片目または両目が突然見えなくなりましたか？

english: Did you suddenly lose your balance or coordination?
transliteration: Totsuzen, baransu o kuzushitari, karada no ugoki o umaku chosei dekinaku nattari shimashita ka?
translation: 突然、バランスを崩したり、体の動きをうまく調整できなくなったりしましたか？

english: What time were you last completely well?
transliteration: Saigo ni mattaku mondai naku sugosete ita no wa nanji desu ka?
translation: 最後にまったく問題なく過ごせていたのは何時ですか？

english: Did the symptoms go away completely?
transliteration: Shojo wa kanzen ni nakunarimashita ka?
translation: 症状は完全になくなりましたか？

english: Did you have the worst headache of your life?
transliteration: Kore made de saiaku no zutsu ga arimashita ka?
translation: これまでで最悪の頭痛がありましたか？

english: Did the headache reach maximum intensity within seconds or a minute?
transliteration: Zutsu no itami wa, suubyo kara ippun inai ni mottomo tsuyoku narimashita ka?
translation: 頭痛の痛みは、数秒から1分以内に最も強くなりましたか？

english: Do you have a fever with a stiff neck?
transliteration: Hatsunetsu to kubi no kowabari ga arimasu ka?
translation: 発熱と首のこわばりがありますか？

english: Have you had a new seizure or lost consciousness?
